# Atom Benchmark Configuration Example
# =====================================
# This example shows how to benchmark Atom with DeepSeek-R1 model.
#
# Atom exposes an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server at
# atom.entrypoints.openai_server and is wire-compatible with vLLM, so
# the bench client reuses --backend vllm under the hood.
#
# Usage:
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/benchmark_atom_dsr1.yaml
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - The `atom` Python package importable in the runtime environment
#   - HuggingFace token (HF_TOKEN) for gated models
#
# Known limitations:
#   - Single-node only. atom upstream has no multi-node TP wiring; the
#     cross-node Ray branch in Magpie/remote/tasks.py logs a
#     "single-node only" warning and skips arg injection.
#
# Profiling: set PROFILE=1 (or torch_profiler.enabled: true below) and
# the launch script passes --torch-profiler-dir to atom. Traces land
# under $ATOM_TORCH_PROFILER_DIR (or $WORKSPACE_DIR/torch_trace) as
# rank_<N>/*.pt.trace.json.gz.

benchmark:
  framework: atom
  model: /shared_nfs/Llamas/huggingface/DeepSeek-R1-0528
  precision: fp8
  run_mode: local

  # Environment variables
  envs:
    TP: 8
    CONC: 32
    ISL: 128
    OSL: 128
    RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO: 0.8
    MAX_MODEL_LEN: 4090
    # EXTRA_ATOM_ARGS: "--your-atom-flag value"

  # Profiler configuration (set torch_profiler.enabled: true to capture
  # traces via atom's --torch-profiler-dir; see header comment).
  profiler:
    torch_profiler:
      enabled: false
    system_profiler:
      enabled: false

  gap_analysis:
    enabled: false
    trace_start_pct: 50
    trace_end_pct: 80
    top_k: 20

  # Optional: Automatically selects idle GPU(s) before launching. Enabled by default;
  # uncomment to override (see docs/how-to/benchmarking/benchmark.md#automatic-gpu-selection).
  # gpu_selection:
  #   auto: true
  #   min_free_memory_gb: 8.0
  #   count: null              # null -> use envs.TP
  #   candidates: [0, 1, 2, 3] # whitelist physical GPU ids

  # Will auto-clone InferenceX if not specified
  # inferencex_path: ""

  # Timeout (DeepSeek-R1 needs time to load)
  timeout_seconds: 3600

# Test: Using InferenceX Native Script
# ========================================
# This config tests the benchmark_script lookup priority:
#   Priority 1: User-specified script in InferenceX/benchmarks/
#   Priority 2: InferenceX native scripts: {prefix}_{precision}_{runner}.sh
#   Priority 3: Magpie generic scripts: {framework}_{runner}.sh

# Usage:
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/test_inferencex_script.yaml
#
# Expected: Should use dsr1_fp8_mi300x.sh from InferenceX

benchmark:
  framework: sglang
  model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528
  precision: fp8
  # run_mode: docker (default) or local
  
  # Environment variables
  envs:
    TP: 8
    CONC: 32
    ISL: 1024
    OSL: 1024
    RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO: 1
    MAX_MODEL_LEN: 131072
    
  # Profiler configuration
  profiler:
    torch_profiler:
      enabled: false
    system_profiler:
      enabled: false
    tracelens:
      enabled: false
      
  # InferenceX path (empty string will auto clone)
  # inferencex_path: ""
  
  # TEST: Specify InferenceX native script directly
  benchmark_script: "dsr1_fp8_mi300x.sh"
  
  # Timeout (DeepSeek-R1 needs time to load)
  timeout_seconds: 3600

# SGLang client-only benchmark against an externally managed server.
# ===================================================================
#
# Magpie does not start or stop the inference server in this mode. Start an
# OpenAI-compatible server separately, make it reachable from this host, and
# set BENCHMARK_BASE_URL below. The Magpie built-in wrapper detects that value
# and runs only the InferenceX benchmark client.
#
# BENCHMARK_BASE_URL should contain only the scheme, host, and port. The
# benchmark endpoint defaults to /v1/completions.
#
# Usage:
#   python -m Magpie benchmark \
#     --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/benchmark_sglang_client_only.yaml

benchmark:
  framework: sglang
  model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8
  precision: fp8
  run_mode: docker
  docker_image: "your-client-image:version"

  # Use a Magpie built-in script: native InferenceX benchmark scripts do not
  # necessarily support BENCHMARK_BASE_URL or client-only execution.
  benchmark_script: "sglang_mi355x.sh"
  timeout_seconds: 3600

  envs:
    # Address of the externally managed OpenAI-compatible inference server.
    BENCHMARK_BASE_URL: "http://server-host-or-ip:8888"

    CONC: 32
    ISL: 1024
    OSL: 1024
    NUM_PROMPTS: 320
    RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO: 1

    # For a chat-only endpoint, uncomment both settings:
    # MAGPIE_BENCHMARK_BACKEND: "openai-chat"
    # MAGPIE_BENCHMARK_ENDPOINT: "/v1/chat/completions"

  # Server-side profiling is unavailable when Magpie does not own the server.
  profiler:
    torch_profiler:
      enabled: false
    system_profiler:
      enabled: false
    tracelens:
      enabled: false

# SGLang AgentX Benchmark Configuration for deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813
# ======================================================================
#
# Usage (Docker - default):
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/benchmark_sglang_deepseek_v4_pro_fp4_mi355x_agentx.yaml
#
# Magpie auto-clones InferenceX at 408c015be4b22d14c69518643609669405507077.
# TP, speculative decoding, KV offload, and CPU DRAM settings come from its
# single-node YAML recipe. Magpie owns the server; InferenceX owns replay.
# Input lengths and target output lengths come from the trace dataset.
# Omit ISL, OSL, and RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO; AgentX ignores them with a warning.
# CONC sets the number of active agent session trees, including their subagents.
# Choose a concurrency point supported by the selected InferenceX recipe.

benchmark:
  framework: sglang
  model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813
  precision: fp4
  run_mode: docker

  # Run the canonical AgentX benchmark.
  agentx: enable

  envs:
    CONC: 32  # Active session trees, not a fixed number of HTTP requests.

  # For a non-publishable test, replace `agentx: enable` with:
  # agentx:
  #   enabled: true
  #   mode: fast

  docker_image: lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260926

# AgentX framework trace capture for diagnosis, not performance comparison.
# Usage:
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/benchmark_sglang_deepseek_v4_pro_fp4_mi355x_agentx_profile.yaml
# Requires a profiler-capable SGLang image. GPU execution is not yet validated.
# Magpie waits for AIPerf's profiling phase, captures a bounded number of
# framework steps, and waits for every rank's trace before cleaning up.
# Three captures share one server and one replay client. The 200-second pause
# starts only after all traces from the preceding capture have finished.
# The count is reduced automatically to fit the replay (canonical default 3600s).
# Completed traces remain; actual capture/flush/server/client errors still fail.
# Per-capture traces: torch_trace/<capture_id>/profile_001/, profile_002/, ...
# Per-capture TraceLens reports: profile_001/, profile_002/, ... in the workspace.
# Results are benchmark_valid=false and publishable=false, including when
# capture succeeds. Use the unprofiled AgentX example for candidate decisions.

benchmark:
  framework: sglang
  model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813
  precision: fp4
  run_mode: docker
  agentx: enable
  envs:
    CONC: 32
  docker_image: lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260926
  profiler:
    torch_profiler:
      enabled: true
      num_steps: 20
      num_profiles: 3
      interval_seconds: 200
      start_seconds: 0  # From measurement start, excluding warmup; must be < duration.
      # To collect one mid-replay window, use num_profiles: 1 and start_seconds: 1800.
      detailed_annotations: false
      # Opt in only with a framework instrumented for annotation/shape discovery
      # (and graph profiling when graphs are enabled). Magpie probes capabilities
      # and configures the framework; this example remains usable with stock traces.
      capture_timeout_seconds: 300
      flush_timeout_seconds: 1800
    tracelens:
      enabled: true
      analysis_mode: pytorch
      auto_patch_runtime: false
      export_format: csv

# SGLang benchmark with Docker server reuse.
#
# Run this config repeatedly with different client values (CONC/ISL/OSL).
# Keep cleanup=false for intermediate runs and set cleanup=true on the final run.

benchmark:
  framework: sglang
  model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8
  precision: fp8
  run_mode: docker
  docker_image: "your-sglang-image:version"
  benchmark_script: "sglang_mi355x.sh"
  timeout_seconds: 7200

  envs:
    TP: 4
    PORT: 8888
    CONC: 1
    ISL: 1024
    OSL: 1024
    NUM_PROMPTS: 32
    RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO: 1
    EXTRA_SGLANG_ARGS: "--context-length 131072 --disable-radix-cache"

  profiler:
    torch_profiler:
      enabled: false

  server_lifecycle:
    enabled: true
    cleanup: false
    force_reuse: false
    server_ready_timeout_s: 2700

# SGLang Benchmark Configuration Example
# =======================================
# This example shows how to benchmark SGLang with DeepSeek-R1 model.
#
# Usage:
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/benchmark_sglang_dsr1.yaml
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - Docker with GPU support
#   - HuggingFace token (HF_TOKEN) for gated models

benchmark:
  framework: sglang
  model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528
  precision: fp8

  # Environment variables (passed to Docker container)
  envs:
    TP: 8                      # Tensor parallel size
    CONC: 32                   # Request concurrency
    ISL: 1024                  # Input sequence length
    OSL: 1024                  # Output sequence length
    RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO: 1      # Random range ratio for input/output length
    MAX_MODEL_LEN: 131072      # Maximum model length
    ENABLE_PROFILIER: True     # Enable profiler

  # Profiler configuration
  profiler:
    # PyTorch profiler (default enabled)
    torch_profiler:
      enabled: true

    # System profiler (rocprof-compute for AMD, ncu for NVIDIA)
    system_profiler:
      enabled: false
      profile_args: []  # e.g., ["-b", "1,2,5,10,11,12,14,16,17"] for rocprof-compute

  # Optional: Override automatic image selection
  # docker_image: "lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.8-rocm700-mi30x"

  # Optional: InferenceX path
  # inferencex_path: "/YOUR_INFERENCEX_PATH/"

  # Optional: Specify benchmark script directly
  benchmark_script: "dsr1_fp8_mi300x.sh"

  # Timeout (seconds)
  timeout_seconds: 3600

#
# Usage:
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/benchmark_vllm_dsv32_mxfp4.yaml
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - Docker with GPU support
#   - HuggingFace token (HF_TOKEN) for gated models

  model: amd/DeepSeek-V3.2-mxfp4
  precision: mxfp4
  run_mode: docker
  
  # Environment variables

    TP: 8
    CONC: 32
    ISL: 1024
    OSL: 1024
    RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO: 1
    MAX_MODEL_LEN: 8192 # 8192 is the minimum, otherwise it can be padded to ISL+OSL+200
    EXTRA_VLLM_ARGS: "--no-enable-prefix-caching --block-size 1"
    VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL: "WARNING" 

    
  # Profiler configuration
  profiler:
    torch_profiler:

    system_profiler:

  gap_analysis:

# =====================================
# This example shows how to benchmark vLLM with the GLM-5.1 MXFP4 model.
#
# Usage:
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/benchmark_vllm_amd_glm51_mxfp4.yaml
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - Docker with GPU support
#   - HuggingFace token (HF_TOKEN) for gated models

  framework: vllm
  model: amd/GLM-5.1-MXFP4
  precision: mxfp4
  run_mode: docker

  # Environment variables
  envs:
    TP: 8
    CONC: 32
    ISL: 1024
    OSL: 1024
    RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO: 1
    MAX_MODEL_LEN: 2248 # ISL + OSL + 200
    EXTRA_VLLM_ARGS: "--no-enable-prefix-caching --block-size 1 --trust-remote-code --tool-call-parser glm47 --reasoning-parser glm45 --enable-auto-tool-choice"

    # AMD performance flags
    VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER: 1

  profiler:
    torch_profiler:
      enabled: true
    system_profiler:
      enabled: false

  gap_analysis:
    enabled: true
    top_k: 100
    find_kernel_sources: false

  # amd/GLM-5.1-MXFP4 needs a recent vLLM ROCm build with MXFP4 + FP4BMM support.
  # Validated on 2026-06-08 (MI355X / gfx950): vLLM loaded the model via the
  # AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4 MoE backend and ran the full benchmark end-to-end with
  # VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 (no AITER ZeroDivisionError observed).
  docker_image: "vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly"
  benchmark_script: "vllm_mi355x.sh"

  timeout_seconds: 3600

# vLLM Benchmark Configuration for amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4

#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/benchmark_vllm_amd_mini_max_3_mxfp4.yaml
#
# Usage (Local - run directly on host, e.g. inside a pod):
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/benchmark_vllm_amd_mini_max_3_mxfp4.yaml --run-mode local
#
# Serve flags follow the AMD MXFP4 MI355X baseline from:
#   https://recipes.vllm.ai/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3
# Uses Magpie generic script vllm_mi355x.sh
#
# Validated 2026-09-18 on 8x MI355X (gfx950): TP=8, CONC=32, ISL/OSL=1024
#   request=2.64 req/s, output=2434 tok/s, total=4860 tok/s
#   TTFT mean/p99=143/625 ms, TPOT mean/p99=12.7/14.9 ms

  framework: vllm
  model: amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4
  precision: mxfp4
  run_mode: docker
  gpu_arch: gfx950

  # Environment variables
  envs:
    TP: 8
    CONC: 32
    ISL: 1024
    OSL: 1024
    RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO: 0.8
    MAX_MODEL_LEN: 2248 # ISL + OSL + 200
    # M3 MSA requires block-size 128; parsers are minimax_m3 (not m2).
    EXTRA_VLLM_ARGS: "--no-enable-prefix-caching --block-size 128 --language-model-only --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN --moe-backend aiter --tool-call-parser minimax_m3 --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 --enable-auto-tool-choice"

    # AMD / MiniMax-M3 performance flags
    VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER: 1

# vLLM benchmark with persistent server reuse (local / Magpie built-in scripts)
# ================================================================================
#
# server_lifecycle keeps the vLLM process alive across multiple Magpie invocations
# on the SAME host + PORT. Typical workflow:
#   Run 1: cleanup: false → server starts, stays up after benchmark.
#   Run 2+: cleanup false → benchmarks attach to /health-reachable server only.
#   Final run: cleanup: true → Magpie terminates the persisted server pid group.
#
# Requirements:
#   - run_mode: local
#   - benchmark_script: one of Magpie builtins (vllm_mi300x.sh / vllm_mi355x.sh)
#     Native InferenceX scripts (gptoss_*.sh) do NOT honour MAGPIE_RUN_PHASE.
#   - profiler.torch_profiler.enabled: false unless cleanup: true each time.
#
# Under reuse, timeout_seconds refers to the CLIENT (benchmark_serving.py) slice
# only — it does NOT stop the detached server afterwards.
#
# Final run with cleanup:true (same envs/model as warm runs): see
#   examples/benchmarks/benchmark_vllm_reuse_cleanup.yaml
#
# Usage:
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/benchmark_vllm_local_reuse.yaml

benchmark:
  framework: vllm
  model: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.5
  precision: fp8
  run_mode: local

  timeout_seconds: 3600

  envs:
    TP: 2
    PORT: 8888
    CONC: 4
    ISL: 8192
    OSL: 1024
    RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO: 0.8
    MAX_MODEL_LEN: 131072
    EXTRA_VLLM_ARGS: "--no-enable-prefix-caching --block-size 32 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser minimax_m2 --reasoning-parser minimax_m2_append_think"
    VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER: 1

  profiler:
    torch_profiler:
      enabled: false

  server_lifecycle:
    # enabled: true to enable the server lifecycle
    enabled: true
    # cleanup: true to terminate the persisted server pid group after benchmark
    cleanup: false
    # force_reuse: true to bypass the mismatch errors (metadata mismatch includes tp, port, extra_vllm_args, extra_sglang_args, max_model_len, inferencex_path)
    force_reuse: false 
    # pid_dir defaults to ~/.cache/magpie/server/
    server_ready_timeout_s: 2700

  docker_image: "" # no docker image required for local run
  benchmark_script: "vllm_mi355x.sh"

# vLLM Benchmark with TraceLens Analysis
# =======================================
# Configuration for vLLM benchmarking with TraceLens trace analysis.
#
# Usage:
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/benchmark_vllm_tracelens.yaml
#
# Output:
#   - Torch profiler traces: results/benchmark_vllm_<timestamp>/torch_trace/
#   - TraceLens CSV reports: results/benchmark_vllm_<timestamp>/tracelens/
#   - Simple roofline summaries:
#       results/benchmark_vllm_<timestamp>/tracelens/decode_only_ISL128_OSL128_CONC4_kernel_roofline_simple.csv
#       results/benchmark_vllm_<timestamp>/tracelens/prefilldecode_ISL128_OSL128_CONC4_kernel_roofline_simple.csv
#
# Note: 
#   - num_prompts = CONC * 10 (hardcoded in script), so CONC=4 gives 40 prompts
#   - Smaller CONC/ISL/OSL values for faster profiling runs

benchmark:
  framework: vllm
  model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528
  precision: fp8
  
  # Environment variables (optimized for fast profiling)
  envs:
    TP: 8                    # Tensor parallelism (adjust based on GPU count)
    CONC: 4                  # Request concurrency (num_prompts = CONC * 10)
    ISL: 128                 # Input sequence length
    OSL: 64                  # Output sequence length
    RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO: 1    # Fixed length (no randomness)
    MAX_MODEL_LEN: 4096      # Reduced model length for faster loading
    GPU_MEM_UTIL: 0.85       # GPU memory utilization (lower to avoid OOM)
    ENABLE_PROFILE: "true"   # Enable torch profiler
    
  # Profiler configuration
  profiler:
    # PyTorch profiler - generates JSON traces
    torch_profiler:
      enabled: true          # This sets VLLM_TORCH_PROFILER_DIR
      
    # System profiler (rocprof-compute / ncu)
    system_profiler:
      enabled: false
      
    # TraceLens trace analysis - generates reports from torch traces
    # Commands:
    #   - TraceLens_split_trace
    #   - TraceLens_generate_perf_report_pytorch_inference
    # Set analysis_mode: pytorch for the legacy direct PyTorch report flow.
    tracelens:
      enabled: true               # Enable TraceLens analysis
      analysis_mode: inference    # Default: inference
      analysis_stages: all        # all | [prefilldecode, decode, prefill]
      auto_patch_runtime: true    # Build TraceLens-ready Docker image if needed
      # tracelens_repo_path: /path/to/TraceLens
      # extension_wheel_path: /secure/path/to/TraceLens_extension.whl
      export_format: csv          # "csv" or "excel"
      perf_report_enabled: true   # Single-rank performance report
      multi_rank_report_enabled: true   # Multi-rank collective report
      # gpu_arch_config: null     # Optional: GPU arch config for roofline
      
  # Shorter timeout for minimal run
  timeout_seconds: 1200

#
# Usage (Docker - default):
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/sglang_mi355x/benchmark_sglang_mini_max_3_mxfp8.yaml
#
# Usage (Local - run directly on host, e.g. inside a pod):
#   python -m Magpie benchmark --benchmark-config examples/benchmarks/sglang_mi355x/benchmark_sglang_mini_max_3_mxfp8.yaml --run-mode local

benchmark:
  framework: sglang
  model: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3-MXFP8
  precision: mxfp8
  run_mode: docker
  gpu_arch: gfx950

  # Environment variables
  envs:
    TP: 8
    CONC: 32
    ISL: 1024
    OSL: 1024
    RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO: 0.8
    SGLANG_USE_AITER: 1
    EXTRA_SGLANG_ARGS: "--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3"

  # Profiler configuration
  profiler:
    torch_profiler:
      enabled: false
    system_profiler:
      enabled: false
    tracelens:
      enabled: false

  docker_image: "lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.16-rocm724-mi35x-20260805"
  # hf_cache_path: ""
  benchmark_script: "sglang_mi355x.sh"
  timeout_seconds: 10800

  gap_analysis:
    enabled: false
    top_k: 100
    find_kernel_sources: false
